Vicar of Denbury, cousin of CMY

CMY\'s grandfather the Rev.

Thomas Bargus had an elder sister, Mary, who married Dr.

Bogue, of Farnham.

John Richard Bogue was evidently her grandson.

He married (1840) Sophia Elizabeth Mudge. [S. R.

Flint, Mudge Memoirs (1883), IGI]
